name: Michael "5000" Watts
description: '''Michael "5000" Watts''' (June 7, 1971 – January 30, 2026) was an American DJ, record executive, and entrepreneur who co-founded the record label [[Swishahouse]]. He is credited as one of the primary figures responsible for promoting [[Houston hip-hop]]—particularly its characteristic [[chopped and screwed]] style—to a national audience in the early 2000s.
